verdict.rationale: Pricing page explicitly lists 'BYOC (your VPC) and Hybrid deployments' as an offering, indicating self-hosted/VPC deployment options exist, but there is no dedicated documentation detailing setup, architecture, or infrastructure requirements for such deployments, and no independent/hands-on confirmation. missing for 10: detailed self-hosting/VPC deployment docs, architecture guides, independent confirmation of BYOC actually working, clarity on which components run in customer VPC vs SaaS.
